claims.text: Kecksburg residents interviewed over four decades describe an object shaped like an acorn and about the size of a Volkswagen bearing writing resembling hieroglyphs, removed from the woods by a military operation; resident John Hays has stated since 1990 that as a ten-year-old he saw a flat-bed truck emerging from the site carrying something 'the size of a VW'.
